page.overview:
Who is Hazuki Uchiha?

About two years younger than Fugaku, Hazuki left the clan when she married her husband - a non-Uchiha - and with him had a daughter, Izumi. After her husband died defending their daughter during the Nine-Tailed Demon Fox's Attack, she returned to the Uchiha's compound with Izumi. She was the second to die during the Uchiha Clan Downfall, killed by Itachi Uchiha shortly after Izumi.
